items.hed: Texans: best camp day Sunday, then the Raiders week
items.insight: Club beat (John Harris, Sunday): C.J. Stroud and the offense had their best padded practice of camp. Seven straight seven-on-seven completions after the first PBU; Stroud hit rookie Lewis Bond for a deep TD. Monday is Reliant. Tuesday morning: Raiders at Methodist. Game: Thursday, Aug 20, 7 p.m. CT at Reliant. Preseason.

items.hed: Astros drop the Mariners series, 3-2 on Sunday night
items.insight: MLB: Mariners 3-2 on Sunday Night Baseball at Daikin Park, taking the series 2-1. Houston is 63-62; Seattle 59-66, four back in the AL West. Friday’s walk-off kept Houston from a sweep. Next: Angels, three games starting Tuesday. The window is still open. The rotation is the file.
